　夜も遅いし、今夜はこのまま帰るべきだろう。

An alley is a dead end. Once inside, no one will come to help.
Going into a place like that over nothing more than a noise would be insane.
It was already late; I should go straight home.

Every light in the house was out.
I had never expected to come home this late without so much as calling.
Akiha—Akiha must be furious with me, I thought as I put my hand on the heavy front door.

おはようございます、志貴さま」

“Yes. Good morning, Master Shiki.”
Hisui bowed deeply.
“Right… good morning, Hisui.”
I answered and sat up.
This was my room, and Hisui had apparently come to wake me just as she had yesterday.
“Thanks. I’ll come to the sitting room as soon as I’m dressed, so you can go on ahead.”
“Very well. I shall wait for you there.”
Hisui nodded and walked toward the door.

lines.japanese:
「あ――――――――ぐっ…………！？」
　床に倒れる。
　びちゃり、という音。
　見れば床は所々が血まみれで、机の下には何十人という、クラスメイトたちの亡骸が放置されていた。
「な―――――――」
　立ちあがろうと腕をたてて、倒れた。
　体に力が入らない。
　熱。
熱が、急速に、冷めていく。
lines.label: s234
lines.maoEnglish:
“Ah—gh…!”
I fell to the floor
with a wet splash.
Blood covered the floor in patches.
Beneath the desks lay the bodies of dozens of my classmates.
“What—” I braced an arm to rise, then collapsed again.
I couldn’t muster any strength.
My warmth—my warmth was draining away with terrifying speed.

「安心して、志貴くん。
貴方は他の人たちみたいにはしないから。
ずっとそうして、わたしの声だけを聞いていてくれればいいんだよ」

lines.label: s234
lines.maoEnglish:
“Don’t be afraid, Shiki. I won’t do to you what I did to the others. You only have to stay there forever and listen to my voice.”
―――A cold voice.
I understood nothing of what was happening.
Nothing at all—yet I understood with nauseating certainty that it was wrong.

lines.label: s234
lines.maoEnglish:
“Ghh—!”
I forced strength into my limbs and crawled.
Even that became impossible when her voice stopped me.
“No. You can’t escape anymore, and I won’t let you.
Now, where should I begin spreading my world? Right here, perhaps. You’ll help me, won’t you, Shiki? You broke your promise to save me when I was in trouble, so from now on you’ll indulge every selfish wish I have.”
Her muffled laughter followed.

lines.maoEnglish:
My heartbeat receded into the distance.
The fragrance of the blood flooding the floor made consciousness slip away.
And I understood that if I ever woke again,
I would never feel the warmth of my own body.
In the classroom lit only by moonlight,
Satsuki Yumizuka slowly sank her fangs into Shiki Tohno’s throat.
